title: Minkowski Proof Bulk Issuance
objective: Reduce live Minkowski proof-prime admission to one exact representative and principal-witness construction while preserving transactional and detached proof authority
references: Frozen C4 baseline at origin/class-group 31448489: 27.078s cold proof, 25.245s unconditional phase, 36 representative and 36 principal constructions for 12 proof primes
Independent authority review: SAFE after uninterrupted-path narrowing and exact witness-payload binding

oracles: C4 quintic exact public and detached proof replay
Existing terminal proof progress and checkpoint tamper tests

handoff.summary: Three coherent commits are pushed: typed class-unit cache authority (989f5821), Sage-mode freeze and exact context-policy binding (bb54df54), and uninterrupted Minkowski proof bulk issuance (5747481d). The final exact C4 run constructs one representative and one principal witness per each of 12 proof primes, preserves exact public and detached replay, and reduces the unconditional phase from 25.245s to 20.140s (-20.2%) and cold proof from 27.078s to 21.947s (-18.9%). The conditional median changed from 0.912s to 0.899s. Focused hostile/cancellation/retry tests, the C4 terminal test, build, strict Python, and lane checks pass. Independent reviews marked both cache authority and proof issuance SAFE.
risks: architecture:check reaches package-graph validation but needs the integration-owned number-field-global-arithmetic byte budget raised from 1,500,000 to at least 1,505,450 for the combined cache and proof source
The cumulative native suite is intentionally integration-owned so the overlapping adaptive-hR and proof-bulk changes receive one exact combined native receipt
next_steps: Raise only the measured lazy package byte budget, then run architecture:check and one cumulative test:native on the integrated source
